name: StockWorks
description: StockWorks tracks 3D printing materials, hardware, merch, inventory movements, quotes, incoming MakerWorks jobs, and PrintLab loaded-tray visibility.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Host port for the StockWorks web UI.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID that owns files written by StockWorks.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID that owns files written by StockWorks.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: File creation mask.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Optional PostgreSQL DSN. Leave blank for SQLite.

variables.name: StockWorks DB Schema
variables.description: Optional PostgreSQL schema for StockWorks-owned tables.

variables.name: Data Directory
variables.description: Internal StockWorks data directory.

variables.name: Database Filename
variables.description: SQLite filename under STOCKWORKS_DATA_DIR.

variables.name: Admin Username
variables.description: Admin login username.

variables.name: Admin Email
variables.description: Optional admin email.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Admin login password. Use a strong password.

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Long random secret used to sign session cookies.

variables.name: HTTPS-Only Session Cookie
variables.description: Set 1 when StockWorks is accessed only via HTTPS.

variables.name: PrintLab Base URL
variables.description: Optional PrintLab URL used to read loaded AMS trays.

variables.name: PrintLab API Key
variables.description: Optional PrintLab API key.

variables.name: PrintLab Bearer Token
variables.description: Optional PrintLab bearer token.

variables.name: PrintLab Username
variables.description: Optional PrintLab username for Basic auth.

variables.name: PrintLab Password
variables.description: Optional PrintLab password for Basic auth.

variables.name: PrintLab API Auth Header
variables.description: Header name PrintLab expects for PRINTLAB_API_KEY.

variables.name: PrintLab Trace Logging
variables.description: Set 1 to enable PrintLab integration trace logs.
